name: Blue-capped Redstart
rangeDescription: Montane juniper and pine forest of southern asia
description: An odd small redstart of open dry forests. Male doesn’t look like any other redstarts; somewhat resembles magpie-robins, which do not share its range.

name: Biak Monarch
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A rare, medium-sized bird of lowland forest on Biak Island. Pale yellow belly and undertail, black chest and upperparts, except for large pale yellow patches on the wing and an irregular triangular shape behind the eye.

name: Black-crowned Barwing
rangeDescription: Western highlands of vietnam
description: The black crown and wingtips of this gray-headed barwing set it apart from other species within its range. Bright white eyering gives it a “goggled” appearance.

name: Magellanic Diving-Petrel
rangeDescription: Islands and fiords of southern chile, southern argentina, and far southeastern brazil
description: Very small diving seabird. Fairly common locally in fjords, channels, and the Strait of Magellan, where it can be seen from shore and ferries; uncommon out in open ocean.

name: Ludwig's Bustard
rangeDescription: Far southwestern angola to namibia, southwestern botswana, and south africa
description: A large-to-medium-sized bustard with a dull orangish nape and hind neck, and dark gray-brown fore neck and face. Female and juvenile are smaller than male and paler on the face and throat.

name: Eurasian Golden Oriole
rangeDescription: Western palearctic to eastern siberia; winters to africa
description: Male unmistakable: golden-yellow with black wings and tail; female and immature greenish yellow overall with dusky wings and variable, fine dark streaking below; note powerful-looking reddish-pink bill in all plumages (dullest in immature). Favors deciduous and mixed woodland and parks, especially with tall leafy trees; can wind up in more open habitats on migration.

name: Sulawesi Honey-buzzard
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region, including togian, banggai, and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi) and muna and buton (to southeast)
description: A small-headed, long-tailed raptor from Sulawesi and the Banggai Islands. Adult shows a dark crested head, a pale throat with dark central stripe, a rufous breast with bold streaking, and a barred belly.

name: Yellow Bunting
rangeDescription: Honshu (japan); winters to eastern china, northern philippines, and taiwan
description: Adult has yellow-green head and breast; both sexes have brown wings, yellow bellies, whitish vents, narrow white wingbars, and white eyering. Male is brighter in plumage, with small black patch between eye and bill.

name: Yellow-lored Bristlebill
rangeDescription: Southeastern nigeria to central african republic; bioko
description: An unusual and colorful rainforest bulbul. The upperparts are dark olive-green and the underparts yellow.

name: Cinnamon Ibon
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (mountains of mindanao)
description: A fairly small to medium-sized bird of montane forest and edge on Mindanao. Bright cinnamon on the crown and back with darker wings and tail, a pale orange throat, chest, and sides, and white on the belly and under the base of the tail.

name: Great Blue Turaco
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of western and central africa
description: Wonderful, cartoonish bird. Note the tall black crest and the red-and-yellow bill.

name: Long-tailed Fantail
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (larat, yamdena, and maru)
description: A small brown songbird with a long tail, often held cocked or fanned. Upperparts largely rufous except for a grayer head with a pale brow.

name: Reunion Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Forest of northwestern réunion (western mascarene islands)
description: Fairly small, slim cuckooshrike in which males and females are strikingly different. Males are mostly gray with black wings and tail.

name: Rufous Songlark
rangeDescription: Australia (except northern cape york peninsula and interior western australia)
description: Plain brownish songbird with faint pale eyebrow and rust-colored rump. Similar female White-winged Triller has white-edged wing panel.

name: Red-crested Bustard
rangeDescription: Southern angola to northeastern namibia, botswana, southern zambia and northern southern africa
description: A medium-sized, black-bellied bustard with diagnostic white chevrons on a brown-and-black mottled back. The male has a brown-gray neck and slaty cap, and the female is plainer.

name: Great Woodswallow
rangeDescription: Mountains of new guinea
description: A medium-sized bird of forest edge, clearings and even towns in the mountains. Dark, slaty gray upperparts and hood down to upper chest.

name: Ultramarine Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Eastern and central solomon islands
description: A distinctive medium-sized blue-and-white kingfisher with a prominent dark mask, blue crown, bright white neck and underparts, blue wings and back, and reddish undertail. Male has a white rump.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Paria Redstart
rangeDescription: Northeastern venezuela (humid cloud forest of paría peninsula)
description: Very active and striking warbler that flicks wings and flashes white spots in tail while foraging. Has bright yellow underparts, slate gray upperparts and head, dark red crown, white in tail, and yellow spectacles.

name: Indian Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Foothills of northern and central india (western ghats)
description: Only nuthatch in most of its range with gray upperparts and brick-red underparts. From crown to upper mantle, the gray is a lighter shade than the remainder of the upperparts.

name: Worthen's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Northeastern mexico (coahuila to nuevo león, zacatecas, and veracruz)
description: Very local, scarce, and endangered small sparrow of desert plateau in northeast Mexico. Mainly found in rolling, short-cropped grassland (especially prairie-dog towns), with scattered yuccas and junipers.
